background.transition: color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), opacity 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1)

dropdown.animation: scaleY from 0 to 1 on transform, opacity 0.4s, with cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) easing; submenu items staggered opacity with 0.125s incremental delays

characterDescription: A precision luxury retail navigation system built on restraint and craft — every interaction is choreographed with an elastic cubic-bezier easing (0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) that gives links and overlays a soft, overshooting deceleration reminiscent of high-end fashion editorial motion design. The floating, offset header (fixed with margin from viewport edges) and the animated underline links signal confident minimalism with typographic discipline.
